messages:
nina: Pushed a new hero direction for the three-mode landing. Trying a ribbon-first layout: short headline, ribbon with benchmark summary, then main CTA block. Need quick alignment.
leo: ribbon-first sounds smart44d reduces cognitive load. can you paste the three short headlines you sketched?
nina: yep: 
- Hosted API: 'Start fast — transparent performance & pricing'
- Dedicated: 'Reserved GPU capacity with SLAs'
- Private: 'Deploy inference inside your network'
ada: two microcopy notes: 1) avoid the word "capacity" on the hero for hosted, sounds too infra-y, 2) make Dedicated CTA less salesy - maybe "Estimate capacity" as secondary.
rachel: on benchmarks ribbon: keep it human-forward. propose: "Benchmarked on real apps: lower latency and big cost savings. Watch the breakdown." -> link to benchmarks page/modal.
leo: for the benchmarking line include a small stat if we can validate it: e.g., "~30% lower median latency" or "up to 4x cheaper". but if we don't have a universal stat, use ranges like "substantial cost savings"
nina: agreed. i'll use: "Benchmarks show lower latency and substantial cost savings; see our webinar for workload details."
prod-bot: Reminder: marketing deploy preview will run when branch `marketing/hero-ribbon-v1` is created.
rachel: webinar plan: Mar 2, 10am PT. Title idea: "Serving LLMs in production: latency, cost, and deployment choices". short sign-up line for modal (50 chars): "Live benchmarks, tradeoffs, and a demo  Mar 2"
ada: inbound routing: map CTAs to UTMs -> Hosted: `?src=hero_ribbon&mode=hosted`, Dedicated: `?src=hero_ribbon&mode=dedicated`, Private: `?src=hero_ribbon&mode=private`. Form posts should include `intent` param (eval|prod) and `lead_score=auto` when available.
leo: SDR routing: high-intent (intent=prod OR request_trial clicked) -> route to enterprise queue; intent=eval or estimate_cost -> route to self-serve nurture. we'll share exact webhook mapping.
nina: AB tests: Variant A (ribbon beneath headline), B (bench ribbon above headline), C (no ribbon, inline blurb). We should test CTAs too: Try API vs Get API Key for Hosted.
rachel: design notes: ribbon should be 40px high, muted background, micro-copy at 14px. modal for full benchmarks: include 3 small charts + 1-line takeaway per chart.
prod-bot: Note: add `utm_campaign=hero_ribbon_Q1` to all CTA links so analytics can attribute correctly.
ada: small legal note for Private trial: include GDPR/data residency snippet on the form so legal can approve.
leo: timeline: finalize copy Wed, design mock Thu, engineering implements preview Fri. objections?
nina: no objections. I'll update the doc and create branch. tagging @leo @ada @rachel for final pass.
